title: forge trace data
description: Payload of `forge trace --json`. Same document as `run` — the difference is the JSON trace `trace` writes to stderr, not the envelope.

file.description: Program file, or the manifest path when `--manifest` was used.

result.description: The program's return value, or `null` when it returned nothing (`Unit`).

anyOf.title: blocked
anyOf.description: Static checks failed, so the program never started; `error.type` is `check`.
